verdicts.reason: A: the green circle has come off the phone and now sits behind the headline. The headline breaks badly, leaving 'back' alone on its own line. The subcopy wraps awkwardly, and the small CTA is stacked in with two badges of about the same size, so it gets lost; the right-hand column is cramped while the lower left is empty. B: the phone and circle stay together, but the SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The two badges have grown to the full size of the CTA, which flattens the hierarchy, and the headline is jammed against the top edge. Even so, B is more coherent than A.
